plan.name: Count observed decision calls toward in-place proofs
plan.summary: Implement D-0416 by adding an optional observe list of source/symbol references to an existing Python component check with exhaustive conformance, resolving and pinning those functions alongside the selected worker, and allowing a separate in-place proof selection for an observed function without its own conformance invocation. Exploration records completed calls made inside application entries as ordered calls on their attempt observations, each with target, source_sha256, arguments bound by parameter name and result, using copied JSON values with exact integers; validate the staged callable, entry ownership, authenticated transport, replay consistency and complete execution, and keep calls outside entries from earning evidence. A proof may additionally qualify when the same completed exploration invocation records that declaration on both accepted and declared-refused non-replay attempts, beside passing transition, state and attempted-step conformance in the same session against the proof's source bytes; missing, accepted-only, refused-only, sampled, stale or failed evidence cannot qualify it, and the existing proof, trusted-contract, selected-function and hold/release rules remain intact. Preserve the declarations and call evidence through staging, JSON, fingerprints and receipt requalification, explain missing call coverage in diagnostics, and update the existing proof admission/diagnostic tests plus add statue-service-shaped execution, gate, transport and receipt regressions, with the existing real-tool opt-in exercising the new fixture. Update SPEC.md and the README-linked docs/python.md to describe the declaration, evidence and additional qualification route, citing D-0416 and D-0260 in the changed SPEC bullets; the decision authorizing this change is already recorded.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateObservedDecision793
tests.says: A decision function proved in place qualifies from its recorded arguments and results on admitted and refused entries while the selected worker retains its held-call and conformance behavior.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateObservedDecisionCoverage793
tests.says: A named function that is never called, called only on accepted or only on refused attempts, or called outside the entry cannot qualify its proof, even with passing worker conformance.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationObservedCallTransport793
tests.says: Authenticated call records still require matching declarations and entry attempts, replay consistency and exact portable values; malformed call evidence invalidates the execution.

tests.name: TestObservedDecisionProofReceipt793
tests.says: JSON and Markdown retain observed call evidence and count the proof only while both outcomes, the matching complete execution, source bytes and passing conformance remain present.
